report: Iteration-2 re-review of PR #2015 (adds Step 8.5 suite-runtime profiling pass + Step 8.6 ceiling tripwire to skills/retrospective-weekly/SKILL.md, plus changeset). All four prior-iteration findings are confirmed fixed against HEAD a986f7b: (1) Step 8.5 now invokes `lib/test/profile-suite.py run --with-modules` and the prose correctly explains that bare `run` defaults to the monolith shard which skips the module tier — verified against profile-suite.py:449-537 where the absence of --with-modules sets DEVFLOW_SKIP_SUITE_MODULES=1/DEVFLOW_SKIP_PYTHON_POOL=1; (2) both `gh issue create` sites are guarded `if URL="$(...)" && [ -n "$URL" ]` so an empty URL never reaches apply-labels.sh; (3) both dedup queries route on the query's own exit status (`if EXISTING="$(gh issue list ...)"; then ... else <skip>`) and fail closed to avoid duplicate filings; (4) elapsed extraction remains advisory by design (non-numeric -> OVER=unknown -> no file). All referenced helpers exist with matching signatures (apply-labels.sh, post-issue-comment.sh <issue> <body-file>, profile-suite.py --with-modules); `BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS` is present in devflow-implement.yml:1653 in the grep-matched shape; `run-parallel: elapsed <N>s` is emitted by run-parallel.sh:654; integer arithmetic (elapsed_s*100000 > 85*ceiling_ms; THRESHOLD_S floor) is correct; jq env.TITLE/env.MARKER are exported before the exact re-match; all lib/test/ references carry pruned-path-ok markers; changeset frontmatter (bump: patch, type: Added) is valid. Writing-skills evidence: a four-slot marker (skill-loaded=yes, guidance-applied=yes, pressure-scenario=no, micro-tests=yes) is present on issue 2010's workpad, discharging the prompt-surface edit gate. No Critical or Important findings. Two non-corroborating Suggestion-grade polish notes were raised (see phase3_findings) — neither is a REJECT-driver. Verdict: APPROVE.

phase3_findings.description: Step 8.6 annotate/dedup branch echoes 'recorded new reading on #$OPEN' unconditionally after `bash post-issue-comment.sh`, which is best-effort and always exits 0 — so the echo asserts success even when the annotation silently failed (a permissions/rate-limit/network breadcrumb goes to stderr only). Inconsistent with the two create paths in the same steps, which gate their 'filed' echo on `&& [ -n "$URL" ]`. Low impact: the tripwire is heads-up-only and the helper's own stderr breadcrumb still surfaces the real outcome. Suggest routing the echo on the helper's exit status or softening it to 'attempted to record'.

Step 8.5's bare fenced `lib/test/profile-suite.py run --with-modules` propagates the child suite's exit status, so a real suite FAIL makes the command exit non-zero. The step is correctly documented as a diagnostic that turns no run red and the profiler still writes its ranking tables, but the prose gives no note that a non-zero exit here is expected/benign rather than a step failure. Suggest one clause stating the exit status is ignored, mirroring Step 8.6's explicit fail-closed spelling.
